name: better-ui (jakubkrehel/skills)
summary: Agent skill that polishes UI surfaces, icons and motion with exact values for radius, shadows, hit areas and animation.
description: A SKILL.md package for AI coding agents covering UI polish: concentric border radius (outer radius equals inner radius plus padding), optical alignment, surface depth, contextual icons, hit areas and motion values such as cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). It defers typography, accessibility, layout and color work to companion skills better-typography, better-accessibility, better-layout and better-colors.
contains: exact values for radius, shadows, icons, hit areas and motion
rules: outer radius equals inner radius plus padding; nudge by eye where geometry looks off
companion skills: better-typography, better-accessibility, better-layout, better-colors
